# Reports the DLCs of the game and the kind of empire of the player, which the client compares
# with the options the multiworld was made with
# Scope: country
ap_report_setup = {
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Ancient Relics Story Pack" } log = "AP_DLC 1" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Apocalypse" } log = "AP_DLC 2" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Astral Planes" } log = "AP_DLC 3" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "BioGenesis" } log = "AP_DLC 4" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Cosmic Storms" } log = "AP_DLC 5" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Distant Stars Story Pack" } log = "AP_DLC 6" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Federations" } log = "AP_DLC 7" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "First Contact Story Pack" } log = "AP_DLC 8" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Galactic Paragons" } log = "AP_DLC 9" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Grand Archive" } log = "AP_DLC 10" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Infernals Species Pack" } log = "AP_DLC 11" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Megacorp" } log = "AP_DLC 12" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Nemesis" } log = "AP_DLC 13" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Nomads" } log = "AP_DLC 14" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Overlord" } log = "AP_DLC 15" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "Shadows of the Shroud" } log = "AP_DLC 16" }
	if = { limit = { host_has_dlc = "The Machine Age" } log = "AP_DLC 17" }
	if = { limit = { has_authority = auth_hive_mind } log = "AP_EMPIRE 2" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_authority = auth_machine_intelligence } log = "AP_EMPIRE 3" }
	else = { log = "AP_EMPIRE 1" }
}

# Scope: country
ap_init_tree_slots = {
	set_variable = { which = ap_trees_adopted value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_adaptability value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_aptitude value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_archivism value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_cloning value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_cybernetics value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_cybernetics_assimilator value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_diplomacy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_discovery value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_domestication value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_domination value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_enmity value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_expansion value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_genetics value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_harmony value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_logistics value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_mercantile value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_modularity value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_mutation value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_nanotech value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_politics value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_prosperity value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_psionics value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_psionics_shroud value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_purity value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_statecraft value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_subterfuge value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_supremacy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_synchronicity value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_synthetics value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_unyielding value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_versatility value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = ap_slot_virtuality value = 0 }
}

# Gives the tree that was just adopted its number
# Scope: country
ap_assign_tree_slots = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_tradition = tr_ap_adaptability_adopt NOT = { has_country_flag = ap_tree_adaptability } }
		set_country_flag = ap_tree_adaptability
		set_variable = { which = ap_slot_adaptability value = ap_trees_adopted }
		change_variable = { which = ap_trees_adopted value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_tradition = tr_ap_aptitude_adopt NOT = { has_country_flag = ap_tree_aptitude } }
		set_country_flag = ap_tree_aptitude
		set_variable = { which = ap_slot_aptitude value = ap_trees_adopted }
		change_variable = { which = ap_trees_adopted value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_tradition = tr_ap_archivism_adopt NOT = { has_country_flag = ap_tree_archivism } }
		set_country_flag = ap_tree_archivism

		change_variable = { which = ap_trees_adopted value = 1 }

	if = {
		limit = { has_tradition = tr_cloning_adopt NOT = { has_country_flag = ap_tree_cloning } }
		set_country_flag = ap_tree_cloning
		set_variable = { which = ap_slot_cloning value = ap_trees_adopted }

	if = {
		limit = { has_tradition = tr_ap_diplomacy_adopt NOT = { has_country_flag = ap_tree_diplomacy } }
		set_country_flag = ap_tree_diplomacy
		set_variable = { which = ap_slot_diplomacy value = ap_trees_adopted }
		change_variable = { which = ap_trees_adopted value = 1 }
